title: Lumenn Frame
description: Lumenn Frame is a cinematic graph editor for Foundry VTT, providing Scene, Audio and Note nodes, directional narrative flow edges, configurable scene/audio transitions, audio continuity, an infinite pan/zoom canvas with Fit All, a contextual Inspector, live GM navigation and GM-to-player synchronization. Primary target Foundry 14.367, backward compatible with 13.350+.
